title: validate/doctor: add Dashboard widget reference integrity check (dataset → dimensions/measures + chartConfig fields)
body:
## Problem

The v9 single-form cutover (ADR-0021) makes every `DashboardWidget` bind a semantic `dataset` and select its `dimensions`/`values` (measures) **by name** (e.g. `sum_amount`, `ticket_count`). But nothing validates that those names — or the `chartConfig` axis fields that mirror them — actually resolve against the referenced dataset. A widget can name a dataset that doesn't exist, a measure the dataset never declares, or point `chartConfig.yAxis[].field` at a stale base column, and **every build-time tool still passes**:

- **`objectstack validate`** — passes. It only runs `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.safeParse(...)` (`packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts`). In the schema, `chartConfig.yAxis[].field` / `xAxis.field` / `series[].name` are plain `z.string()` (`packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts:81,108`, "Data field key"), and a widget's `dataset` / `dimensions` / `values` are just identifier strings with no cross-reference to the dataset's declared `dimensions[]` / `measures[]` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:156-160`). Shape is valid; the *reference* is never checked.
- **`objectstack lint`** — no relevant rule. The only data-model rules are the relationship conventions in `packages/cli/src/lint/data-model-rules.ts` (e.g. `relationship/line-item-should-be-master-detail`) plus i18n coverage. Nothing for dashboards/datasets/charts.
- **`objectstack doctor`** — already does cross-reference integrity for *views* (`findOrphanViews` → "View integrity — All views reference valid objects", `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts:72`), unused objects, and circular deps — but has **no equivalent for dashboard widgets**.
- **`objectstack build`** (= compile) — same schema/protocol checks as validate; doesn't catch it.

The result is a **silent** failure class: build is green, the page is broken.

## Impact (downstream evidence)

The cutover broke two widget classes in `objectstack-ai/templates` with a fully green build:

1. **Record-listing `type:'table'` widgets** bound to aggregate datasets with only a `count` measure and no dimension collapsed to a single number (they were meant to list rows). Fixed manually by re-modeling as object-bound ListViews — [templates#27](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/templates/pull/27) (19 widgets across 11 dashboards).
2. **Chart widgets (bar/line/pie)** whose `chartConfig.yAxis[].field` still named the old base column (`amount`, `total_amount`, sometimes a placeholder `value`) while post-cutover data is keyed by the dataset's **measure** name (`sum_amount`, `ticket_count`). Field doesn't resolve → axis labels render but the **series is empty**. A second variant had **no `chartConfig` at all**, so the component can't tell which measure to plot → also empty. **17 charts across the 11 dashboards rendered blank.** Fix incoming (branch `fix/dashboard-chart-bindings`).

Both were invisible until someone opened each page. A build-time check would have caught all 36 at author time.

## Minimal reproduction

A dataset declaring measure `sum_amount`, and a bar widget whose `yAxis.field` names the old base column `amount`:

```ts
// dataset: measure is "sum_amount"
const expenseLineMetrics: Dataset = {
  name: 'expense_line_metrics',
  object: 'expense_line',
  dimensions: [{ name: 'category', field: 'category' }],
  measures: [{ name: 'sum_amount', aggregate: 'sum', field: 'amount', certified: true }],
};

// widget: values is correct, but chartConfig.yAxis.field points at the raw column
const widget = {
  id: 'spend_by_category',
  dataset: 'expense_line_metrics',
  dimensions: ['category'],
  values: ['sum_amount'],
  type: 'bar',
  chartConfig: {
    type: 'bar',
    xAxis: { field: 'category' },
    yAxis: [{ field: 'amount' }], // ❌ no measure named "amount"; data returns "sum_amount"
  },
};
```

`objectstack validate` and `objectstack build` both pass. At runtime the bar chart shows the category axis and an empty series. The same happens if `chartConfig` is omitted on a chart-type widget.

## Expected

A build-time check (no running server needed) should fail or warn with a specific, actionable message, e.g.:

```
✖ Dashboard widget integrity
  Widget "spend_by_category": chartConfig.yAxis[0].field "amount" does not
  resolve to a measure of dataset "expense_line_metrics" (declared measures:
  sum_amount). Did you mean "sum_amount"?

  Widget "spend_by_category": chart-type widget has no chartConfig — the
  component cannot determine which measure to plot.

⚠ Widget "pending_reports_table": type 'table' is bound to dataset
  "expense_report_metrics", which declares only a count measure and no
  dimension. This is almost certainly a flat record listing — model it as an
  object-bound ListView (ADR-0017), not a dashboard widget.
```

## Proposed: "Dashboard widget reference integrity" check

Add a check (mirroring the existing `findOrphanViews` view-integrity pass in `doctor.ts`) that resolves each `DashboardWidget` against its dataset. For every widget assert:

- **(a)** `dataset` resolves to a declared `Dataset`.
- **(b)** every `dimensions[]` entry is a real dimension name on that dataset (`DatasetDimensionSchema.name`).
- **(c)** every `values[]` entry is a real measure name on that dataset (`DatasetMeasureSchema.name`).
- **(d)** if `chartConfig` is present: `xAxis.field` resolves to one of the widget's dimensions (or a dataset dimension); each `yAxis[].field` and `series[].name` resolves to one of the widget's measures (values). For a chart-type widget (`bar`/`line`/`pie`/…) with **no** `chartConfig`, warn that no measure mapping exists.
- **(e)** warn when a `type:'table'`/`'pivot'` widget is bound to a dataset that declares only a `count`-style measure and no dimension — almost certainly a flat record listing that should be a ListView (ADR-0017).

**Best landing spot:** the same place views are already checked. Two complementary options:

1. **`doctor`** — extend the integrity section (`findOrphanViews`/`findUnusedObjects`, `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts:72-156`) with `findOrphanWidgets(config)` that walks `dashboards[].widgets[]` and resolves dataset → dimensions/measures the same way. Lowest-friction; reuses the existing reporting UX ("View integrity … / Dashboard integrity …").
2. **`validate`** — add a semantic pass after `safeParse` succeeds (`packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts`), so the failure surfaces in CI/`build` where the cutover damage actually occurred. (a)–(c) are hard errors; (d) error on a present-but-wrong field, warn on missing `chartConfig`; (e) is a warning.

There's a clean precedent for the name-resolution itself: the dataset schema's `superRefine` already resolves **derived measure** references *by name within a dataset* (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`, e.g. "derived measure cannot reference itself" / references-undeclared-measure). This proposal is the same resolution, extended across the dashboard → dataset → dimension/measure boundary. Doing it in `validate`/`doctor` (rather than the spec schema) keeps it where multi-package config is already assembled, so a widget in one package can resolve a dataset in another.

## References

- `objectstack-ai/templates` [#27](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/templates/pull/27) — record-listing tables → ListViews (downstream fix for failure class 1).
- Forthcoming `objectstack-ai/templates` PR — "fix 17 chart widget bindings" (failure class 2).
- ADR-0021 (`docs/adr/0021-analytics-dataset-semantic-layer.md`) — single-form widget cutover.
- ADR-0017 (`docs/adr/0017-object-has-many-view.md`) — object-bound ListViews for record listings.
